documents.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
documents.expectedFacts: LoRA freezes pretrained weights and learns low-rank updates.

documents.title: Self-Instruct: Aligning Language Models with Self-Generated Instructions
documents.expectedFacts: Self-Instruct generates instructions using a language model and filters them.

documents.title: LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models
documents.expectedFacts: LLaMA is a collection of foundation language models trained on publicly available datasets.

documents.title: Segment Anything
documents.expectedFacts: Segment Anything introduces promptable image segmentation.

documents.title: RWKV: Reinventing RNNs for the Transformer Era
documents.expectedFacts: RWKV combines recurrent inference with transformer-like parallel training.

documents.title: QLoRA: Efficient Finetuning of Quantized LLMs
documents.expectedFacts: QLoRA finetunes a frozen 4-bit quantized model with low-rank adapters.

documents.title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
documents.expectedFacts: DPO optimizes preferences without fitting a separate reward model.

documents.title: Chatbot Arena: An Open Platform for Evaluating LLMs by Human Preference
documents.expectedFacts: Chatbot Arena uses human preferences from pairwise model comparisons.

documents.title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
documents.expectedFacts: Generative Agents combines memory, reflection and planning.

documents.title: HuggingGPT: Solving AI Tasks with ChatGPT and its Friends in Hugging Face
documents.expectedFacts: HuggingGPT coordinates models using a language model as a controller.

limitations: Thirty authored, partly parallel fixtures and ten public papers; this is not a general multilingual benchmark.
Catalan and mixed-language stress cases occur in development only; Basque and Latin have one positive evaluation query each.
